view: Fustat excavated domestic courtyard close elevated view into roofless low red-brown brick rooms, doorway threshold and ceramic drain channel, a few plain pottery sherds naturally on ground, no pyramids or monumental mosque, archaeologically modest foundations.

eras.title: Inside a house without a roof
eras.caption: The excavated houses of Fustat preserve courtyards, passages and the outlines of rooms. Egypt's early Islamic capital was also a place of workshops and everyday trade, a story still visible in brickwork and the pottery left beneath later Cairo.
